description: This file defines the RequestException class in the GuzzleHttp library, representing HTTP request exceptions with methods for wrapping, creating, and retrieving request/response details.

classes.name: RequestException
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request exception, providing access to the request, response, and context information, and factory methods for creating exceptions based on response status.

methods.name: wrapException
methods.description: Wraps a non-RequestException throwable into a RequestException, associating it with a request.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new RequestException with a normalized error message based on the response status code.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request that caused the exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response was received for the request.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Retrieves contextual information about the error from the handler.
